figurative_meaning_en: Pouring water on the funeral pyre, symbolizing performing the last rites for the deceased
similar_in_english: No one to mourn at my grave
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার চিতায় জল দেওয়ার কেউ নেই।
তার মৃত্যুর পর চিতায় জল দেওয়ার জন্য কেউ এল না।
example_sentences_in_english: There is no one to pour water on my pyre.
No one came to perform the last rites by pouring water on his pyre.
history: Refers to the Hindu cremation ritual where water is poured on the pyre to extinguish the fire after the body is cremated, symbolizing the completion of funeral rites.
note: The idiom specifically alludes to the absence of family or loved ones to perform this ritual, emphasizing themes of abandonment in death.
